An unlucky childhood friend of the [url=/c94631]protagonist[/url] who gets caught up in his succubus summoning ceremony and goes to the other world with him. She has lived next door to the protagonists for a long time and she has been in love with him for a long time. At first glance, she is cold and sharp but she is nice and gentle underneath it all. She is vulnerable to the protagonist's requests and falls to them every time. She always shows a pompous, arrogant attitude while accepting his requests to avoid looking too happy. She is awkward and unable to express her true feelings, so she often fights with him.

The protagonist started his own "occult study group" that she checked up on occasionally because she gets worried about him. When she was a normal person in a normal school, she was enrolled in a swimming club. She joined Faren'ch Deshka's swimming club when she enrolled (but the erotic design of the swimsuit still confuses her).

Because of the special rules of Faren'ch Deshka Academy (no panties allowed), Mako has behaved more like a girl in front of the protagonist then ever before.
